concerns.text: T001 requires `code/main.py` exposing `--stage {download,filter,simulate,aggregate,all}` and documenting the runnable command `python -m code.main --stage all` in quickstart.md, but the stage modules (download_datasets.py, filter_datasets.py, simulate_power.py, aggregate_results.py) are produced by T002–T008. As ordered, T001 must either contain placeholder imports (forbidden by its own 'no placeholder paths' clause) or ship a main.py that fails at runtime. Specify lazy/per-stage imports or move the quickstart 'runnable command' documentation to T012 where the command actually works.
